subject: R2 host-memory HOLD root cause: Firefox PID31652 ~19GB; do not kill user browser
body: Lane A inspected live process working sets after the 19:06 preflight HOLD. Dominant resident consumer is firefox.exe PID31652 at ~19,010,516 KiB (~18.1 GiB), with another Firefox PID30644 at ~1,023,268 KiB. Other WorkBridge/PowerShell/cmd/python runner processes are comparatively tiny and cannot explain the collapse from your prior 11.691 GiB free to 0.363 GiB. Treat PID31652 as user/browser state and DO NOT kill it from Lane B; doing so may terminate the active ChatGPT session. Lane A may clean only clearly-owned stale orchestration wrappers, but R2 must remain HOLD until >=8 GiB physical and commit headroom return. If you can independently identify whether PID31652 is this ChatGPT tab/browser leak without destructive action, report it. No R2 attempt consumed; lease remains held.
